_note: vth-cases-run-end-to-end: `inspectionChecklist` names the inspection checklist template a case of this type is inspected with, so the case page places the checklist widget by what the case type declares instead of by case type name. A case type without it shows no checklist. caseType moves to 1.49.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema (1.48.0 is social-domain-consent-and-safeguards; renumber at merge if 1.49.0 is taken).

inspectionChecklist.title: Inspection checklist
inspectionChecklist.description: The id of the inspection checklist template a case of this type is inspected with. Empty shows no checklist on the case.
